problem: BeBee needs a first-region Honey structure that cannot be soft-locked by upgrade/seed spending and a vertical-slice upgrade set whose tracks have clear player-facing purpose. Yield remained unresolved because an income multiplier can become a timing spreadsheet, trap, or universal opener.

decision.rationale: With Yield removed, all 5040 full priority permutations across Buzz 2/3, Flight 2/3 and three seed sinks complete Region 1 with zero replay and non-negative balance. The historical 1.15x Yield candidate repays only at M06: earliest purchase ends +11 Honey versus no Yield, mid -1 and late -15; 1.10x never repays in Region 1 while 1.20x moves toward a stronger economic opener. Flight and Buzz have direct experiential roles, so the vertical slice intentionally uses two tracks rather than preserving a third card for symmetry.

candidate_pool.name: Cow Bay
candidate_pool.relevance: Compact gather/resource/progression cadence and an explicit energy anti-pattern.

candidate_pool.name: Forager
candidate_pool.relevance: One economy funds capability and expansion, making purchase-order safety relevant.

candidate_pool.name: Dreamdale
candidate_pool.relevance: Output-increase upgrades provide a comparison for Yield-style economy multipliers.

candidate_pool.name: My Little Universe
candidate_pool.relevance: Active gathering and world expansion reference for short-session progression cadence.

selected_references.name: Cow Bay economy cadence
selected_references.selection_reason: Compact browser progression reference and useful energy anti-pattern.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Poki describes gathering/crafting progression and task energy cost.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should test whether campaign content funds itself rather than hiding an underfunded economy behind waiting/energy.

selected_references.name: Forager shared economy
selected_references.selection_reason: Shows why one resource funding multiple useful sinks needs purchase-order safety analysis.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Resources/economic activity support skills, tools and land expansion.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should stress optional spending before required progression gates.

selected_references.name: Dreamdale output upgrades
selected_references.selection_reason: Closest comparison for an output-improvement purchase like Yield.
selected_references.inference: Familiarity does not prove a Honey multiplier is an interesting BeBee choice; payback and timing must be measured.

anti_pattern.observation: Cow Bay explicitly uses energy per task.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not solve an underfunded first-region economy by adding waiting/energy; no-replay arithmetic must pass directly.

official_docs.verified_constraint: itertools.permutations enumerates ordered arrangements and is used to exhaustively cover the seven retained purchase priorities (7! = 5040).
The standard json module provides deterministic configuration/report serialization for the checked-in simulation evidence.

alternatives.reason: Not required for no-grind progression; only the earliest allowed timing beats the no-Yield baseline in Region 1 and payback occurs at M06.
Sensitivity changes the timing answer rather than creating a direct experiential purpose: 1.10x never repays in Region 1 while 1.20x moves toward a stronger economic opener.
Both tracks change direct play capability and all 5040 retained-sink priority orders remain replay-free and non-negative without Yield.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Removing Yield must not make required first-region progression depend on replay.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: evidence/BB-P005/upgrade-set-summary.json records 5040/5040 retained-sink purchase-priority orders passing with total_replay_actions=0.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Customization-heavy spending must remain campaign-safe in the validated structural candidate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The exhaustive set includes all three seed sinks in every full priority permutation; all 5040 orders pass and the all-sink final balance is 271 Honey.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Yield usefulness must be quantified rather than accepted because three upgrade cards look conventional.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Yield comparison records M06 break-even and final deltas of +11 early, -1 mid and -15 late versus no Yield; multiplier sensitivity is also retained.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The decision must not falsely lock current Honey costs/rewards or real-time pacing.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Decision/result docs validate the two-track set and no-grind structural envelope while explicitly keeping exact values, minutes/actions cadence and final effect curves open for P2/P3/P5.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Downstream source-of-truth documents must no longer treat Yield as an unresolved vertical-slice track.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Same PR updates D-007, game design, progression/economy research and README to Flight + Buzz only for the vertical slice.

automated: Trusted PR evidence workflow validates the exact PR candidate using base-branch policy.
manual: Separate evaluator reviewed the original product problem, reference observations, historical Yield payback/sensitivity and the no-Yield exhaustive stress result; verdict PASS WITH DEVIATION.
verification.runtime_errors: none expected/observed in deterministic Python analysis; no production runtime changed
verification.save_data_impact: none; P-1 simulation/research decision only and no production save schema exists

known_limitations: The economy evidence is deterministic arithmetic, not a human time/feel playtest; evidence strength is MEDIUM.
Current costs/rewards remain tuning hypotheses and must be calibrated against production movement/pollination cadence.
The historical Yield candidate remains in the research config intentionally for regression comparison but is marked research_only and is not a production track.
